invariants.rationale: The method always returns Pair.of(...), so result should never be null.
The left component (partitionPathStatMap) of the returned Pair is always a HashMap instance and never null.
The right component (globalStat) of the returned Pair is always a WorkloadStat instance and never null.
Defensive: inputRecords is a method argument operating as the source for grouped computations and thus expected to be non-null when used.
Each entry in the map at most corresponds to a partition path found within the records. There cannot be more partitions than records.
